exercises.title: Memo builder: Birchwood
exercises.intro: Place each Birchwood fact in its CORE-AUTH-02 credit memo section. Section 10, the risk rating, is left out here.

items.text: Approve a $3,520,000 retail bridge to Birchwood Plaza LLC. Committee approval required.
items.why: The answer comes first: amount, product and approver (CORE-AUTH-02; CORE-AUTH-01).

items.text: Dana Whitlow 75% and Leo Marsh 25%. Dana is Tier 1, mid-score 742, liquidity $760,000, net worth $5,200,000.
items.why: Entity, ownership, tier, credit, liquidity and net worth belong in section 2.

items.text: 40,000 sf unanchored strip center, 70% leased. As-is $4,500,000; as-stabilized $6,000,000.
items.why: The property and the values used go in section 3.
Income and expenses go in section 4.

items.text: LTC 68.0% against 70%; in-place coverage 1.08x at the 8.25% test rate.
items.why: Each test against its limit, with rule IDs, goes in the sizing table.

items.text: Exit DSCR 1.36x at 7.75% against 1.30x; exit debt yield 12.3%.
items.why: The exit and its cushion go in section 6.

items.text: Indiana: no lender license or rate cap found; deficiency allowed (SLT-IN-02).
items.why: Section 7 covers CORE-BP-03, CORE-PRC-03 and CORE-DOC-04.

items.text: Indiana rises to 25.9% of the book against a 25% cap; headroom is $2,000,000.
Lease-up of 12,000 sf, paired with Leo Marsh's 9 years of leasing and the cash sweep.
items.why: Each risk is paired with a mitigant (CORE-AUTH-02).

items.text: Rate cap bought and assigned; estoppels and SNDAs in hand; springing lockbox in place.
items.why: Each condition to close is listed in section 11.

exercises.title: Who approves?
exercises.intro: Route five loans to the right approver by always-committee items, exceptions, size and exposure.

start.q: Does any always-committee item apply? These are related-party or employee loans, Tier 0 ground-up, a first loan in a new state, or any CONC breach.

exc.q: How many policy exceptions, and how big?

options.label: One, within credit-officer limits (leverage +2.5 points; DSCR −0.05x; FICO −20; liquidity −10%)
Two, or one beyond credit-officer limits but within committee limits

size0.q: What are the loan size and sponsor exposure (F-CORE-29)?

options.label: Residential, up to $500,000, exposure up to $1,000,000
Any other loan up to $2,000,000, exposure up to $5,000,000

size1.q: What are the loan size and sponsor exposure (F-CORE-29)?

suw.explain: Residential only, up to $500,000 and $1,000,000 of exposure, with no exceptions (CORE-AUTH-01). The approver is never the underwriter of record.

co.explain: Up to $2,000,000 and $5,000,000 of exposure, with at most one exception inside credit-officer limits (CORE-AUTH-01). Any exception still needs two compensating factors (CORE-EXC-02).

committee.explain: Committee approves loans over $2,000,000, exposure over $5,000,000, up to two exceptions and every always-committee item (CORE-AUTH-01; CORE-CONC-07).

decline.explain: Beyond the committee limits no one has authority, so the loan is declined (CORE-AUTH-01).

cases.text: Maple Run: $340,000 residential fix-and-flip. Exposure $340,000, under Dana Reyes's Tier 2 cap. No exceptions.
A $450,000 multifamily loan. The sponsor has no other loans with us. No exceptions.
Dana Reyes asks for 87.5% LTC: $350,000 on Maple Run, one leverage exception of +2.5 points.
A $1,800,000 commercial loan. Sponsor exposure is $5,600,000. No exceptions.
Birchwood: $3,520,000, over Dana Whitlow's Tier 1 cap, and Indiana rises to 25.9% against a 25% cap.

exercises.title: Bucket headroom
exercises.intro: Find how large a new loan North Carolina's state bucket can take, then test Cedar Court's share after it.

calculator.task: The C14 book is $120,000,000, with $26,000,000 in North Carolina and a 25% state cap. What is the headroom before Cedar Court? Does the $5,140,000 loan fit? Check the share after with F-CORE-30: $31,140,000 ÷ $125,140,000.
